ফাংশন ও অন্বয়.exp:
Let, y = f(x) = 2x - 1
or, y = 2x - 1
or, 2x = y + 1
or, x = (y + 1)/2
∴ y = f(x)
Or, f-1(y) = x
or, f-1(y) = (y + 1)/2
∴f-1(x) = (x + 1)/2
